regulations.name: NFPA 99
regulations.description: Referenced for protective earthing and plug current rating requirements

regulations.name: NEC
regulations.description: National Electrical Code, referenced for field wiring, cord types, and tamper-resistant receptacles

requirements.description: To comply with NFPA 99, the enclosure of X-ray ME EQUIPMENT operating over 600 Vac, 850Vdc MAINS VOLTAGE, or containing voltages up to 50 V peak and enclosed in protectively earthed enclosure as well as connections to X-ray tubes and other high voltage components that include high voltage shielded cables are PROTECTIVELY EARTHED.
To comply with NFPA 99, non-current carrying conductive parts of X-Ray ME EQUIPMENT likely to become energized are PROTECTIVELY EARTHED.
EARTH LEAKAGE CURRENT values are not higher than the stated values. No protection earth connection.
To comply with NEC: PERMANENTLY CONNECTED ME EQUIPMENT provided with field wiring provision in accordance with NEC. Remark: Portable equipment.
Exception: Fixed and stationary X-ray ME EQUIPMENT supplied from a branch circuit rated at 30 A or less may use attached hard service flexible cord (Type S or equivalent) for supply connection.
Installation of connecting cords between EQUIPMENT parts comply with NEC. Cable used as external interconnection between units. Remark: No external interconnection cable used.
Cable exposed to abuse: Type SJT, SJTO, SJO, ST, SO, STO, or equivalent, or similar multiple-conductor appliance-wiring material.
Cable not exposed to abuse: Type SPT-2, SP-2, SPE-2, SVr, SVRO, SVE, or equivalent; or assembly of insulated wires with nominal insulation thickness of 0.8 mm (1/32 inch) or more.

Receptacles provided as part of ME EQUIPMENT and ME SYSTEMS for use in patient care areas of pediatric wards, rooms, or areas are listed tamper resistant or employ a listed tamper resistant cover in accordance with NEC.
For ME EQUIPMENT provided with NEMA configuration non-locking plug types 120 V/15 A, 125 V/20 A, 250 V/15 A, 250 V/20 A, 'Hospital Grade' mains plug is provided and the POWER SUPPLY CORD is marked.

The flexible cord is a type acceptable for the particular application, acceptable for use at a voltage not less than the rated voltage of the appliance, and has an ampacity as in NEC not less than the current rating of the appliance. Remark: Internally powered.
To comply with NFPA 99, for X-Ray ME EQUIPMENT with an attachment plug, the current rating on a hospital grade plug is 2X the maximum input current of the equipment.

tests.test_name: Flexible cord type and rating check

semantic_fragments.content: All test items in clauses 8.6.1, 8.7.3d, 8.11, 8.11.3.2, and 8.11.3.3 are marked as N/A. Remarks indicate the device is portable, internally powered, and has no external interconnection cable, which explains the N/A verdicts for many earthing, leakage current, and wiring requirements.

Attachment 2 contains Photo Documentation for Sample YP2407008, Lot KE04, per IEC 60601-1:2005+AMD1:2012+AMD2:2020/EN 60601-1:2006+AC:2010+A1:2013+A12:2014+AC:2016+A2:2021. The attachment is marked DRAFT.
